character.description: An adult industrial designer working alone in a small fabrication workshop, used to validate naturalistic photographic rendering
character.face: natural adult facial proportions with ordinary asymmetry and realistic skin texture
character.hair: short practical hair with natural flyaways
character.costume: simple work shirt, dark trousers and practical closed shoes without branding

style.name: naturalistic-cinematic-photography
style.description: Convincing documentary-cinematic photography with restrained colour, natural lens behaviour, believable skin and materials, and no glossy AI-advertising finish
style.period: contemporary but visually timeless small workshop
style.lighting: soft overcast window light mixed with one warm practical lamp

shots.description: Candid moment of the designer leaning over a workbench inspecting a small physical prototype beside hand sketches and ordinary tools, with a rain-softened window in the background
shots.pose: natural standing lean with one hand resting on the bench and the other holding the small prototype
shots.camera: eye-level 50mm-equivalent documentary perspective from several metres away
shots.expression: quiet concentration rather than smiling at camera
shots.background: small believable fabrication workshop with shelves, timber offcuts, metal tools, paper drawings and a rain-softened window
shots.framing: waist-up to three-quarter environmental portrait with balanced negative space and no aggressive depth-of-field blur
